show: MESS with Sydnee Washington & Marie Faustin

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Sydney Washington and Marie Foston announce the final episode of their podcast.
kurzfassung: Sydney Washington and Marie Foston reveal that this is the final episode of their podcast after the show was canceled by iHeart. The hosts reflect on their journey, read listener submissions about dating drama, and trade jokes about their comedic styles. Despite the show ending, they encourage fans to keep listening and sharing previous episodes.
stichpunkte: The hosts announce that this is the final episode of the podcast.
They discuss the cancellation of the show and joke about the reasons behind it.
Marie recounts a hilarious and frustrating experience getting a man to buy her an air conditioner.
A listener writes in about her best friend moving to Florida and constantly falling in love with new men.
Another listener seeks advice about a new college friend who frequently brings up colorism.
The hosts trade humorous jabs about their contrasting travel habits and packing styles.

clips.hook: guzzling passion fruit margaritas in the sun
clips.text: The host humorously recalls spending her twenties consuming copious amounts of alcoholic drinks in the sun without water while partying heavily on various substances.

clips.hook: is this the week that I die?
clips.text: Marie describes sending a screenshot of a severe heatwave to a man she expected to buy her an air conditioner, asking him if this was the week she would perish.
Marie reacts with disbelief upon learning at the register that a store's return policy on an air conditioner is only fifteen days.

clips.hook: Your shared love of Post Malone is not legally binding
clips.text: The hosts read a listener letter poking fun at a friend who declares every man she meets on dating apps after three days to be her soulmate.

clips.hook: Your friend hit you with some black face makeup
clips.text: The hosts react incredulously to a listener's story about a friend gifting her a foundation that is far too dark for her skin tone.

beschreibung:
Messties ... It's not goodbye, but see you later :,). Today is our last episode FOR NOW. Please enjoy this Sydnee and Marie solo episode of reflection. We may not be releasing on this feed every week, BUT continue to check us out on patreon!
Don't forget to check out this episode and more on our NEW YOUTUBE! https://www.youtube.com/@oohmess
And as always, write in your messy stories at messthepodcast@gmail.com, or call in at (763) 280-6588 to have your MESSages read live on air!
